nahum.2.p1.b1.text: One who scatters advances against you, O Nineveh. Guard the fortress! Watch the road! Brace yourselves! Summon all your strength!

nahum.2.p1.b2.text: For the LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel …

nahum.2.p1.b3.text: The shields of his mighty men are red; the valiant warriors are dressed in scarlet.

nahum.2.p1.b4.text: The chariots dash through the streets; they rush around the plazas, appearing like torches, darting about like lightning.

nahum.2.p1.b5.text: He summons his nobles; they stumble as they advance. They race to its wall; the protective shield is set in place.

nahum.2.p1.b6.text: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.

nahum.2.p1.b7.text: It is decreed that the city be exiled and carried away; her maidservants moan like doves, and beat upon their breasts.

nahum.2.p2.b1.text: Nineveh has been like a pool of water throughout her days, but now it is draining away.

nahum.2.p2.b4.text: “Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold!” There is no end to the treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.

nahum.2.p2.b5.text: She is emptied! Yes, she is desolate and laid waste! Hearts melt, knees knock, bodies tremble, and every face grows pale!

nahum.2.p2.b6.text: Where is the lions’ lair or the feeding ground of the young lions, where the lion and lioness prowled with their cubs, with nothing to frighten them away?

nahum.2.p2.b8.text: Behold, I am against you … I will send your chariots up in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voices of your messengers will no longer be heard.
